name: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor v1.2
description: Capacitive soil moisture sensor v1.2 — outputs an analog voltage inversely proportional to soil moisture. No corrosion vs. resistive probes.

pins.name: AOUT
pins.notes: Analog output: ~3.3V in dry air, ~1.2V submerged. Map to 0–100% moisture.

notes: Must use an ADC1 pin (GPIO32–39) when WiFi is enabled — ADC2 pins are disabled by the WiFi driver. The raw reading needs calibration: dry air value (~3.3V / 4095 counts) maps to 0% moisture; submerged value (~1.2V) maps to 100%. These thresholds vary by sensor unit.
